properties.name: raf.rabbit.enabled
properties.description: Whether to enable the RabbitMQ integration. Must be set to true to activate all RabbitMQ beans.

properties.name: raf.rabbit.addresses
properties.description: Comma-separated list of broker addresses, e.g. host1:5672,host2:5672.

properties.name: raf.rabbit.ssl.enabled
properties.description: Whether to enable SSL/TLS for the RabbitMQ connection.

properties.name: raf.rabbit.ssl.key-store
properties.description: Path to the key store that holds the SSL certificate, e.g. classpath:keystore.p12.

properties.name: raf.rabbit.ssl.key-store-password
properties.description: Password used to access the key store.

properties.name: raf.rabbit.ssl.trust-store
properties.description: Path to the trust store that holds trusted SSL certificates.

properties.name: raf.rabbit.ssl.trust-store-password
properties.description: Password used to access the trust store.

properties.name: raf.rabbit.ssl.algorithm
properties.description: SSL algorithm to use, e.g. TLSv1.2.

properties.name: raf.rabbit.provider.ack
properties.description: Whether to enable publisher confirms and mandatory returns. Enabling this ensures messages are confirmed by the broker but adds latency overhead.

properties.name: raf.rabbit.consumer.group
properties.description: Consumer group name, used as a logical identifier for the listener container group.

properties.name: raf.rabbit.consumer.concurrent-consumers
properties.description: Initial number of concurrent consumers per listener container. Can be overridden per consumer via @RabbitMqConsumer.

properties.name: raf.rabbit.consumer.max-concurrent-consumers
properties.description: Maximum number of concurrent consumers per listener container. Can be overridden per consumer via @RabbitMqConsumer.

properties.name: raf.rabbit.bindings
properties.description: List of topology declarations (exchange, queue, binding). Topology is declared by the producer side on startup.

values.description: Routes messages to queues based on an exact routing key match.
Routes messages to queues based on wildcard routing key patterns.
Broadcasts messages to all bound queues, ignoring routing keys.
Routes messages based on message header attributes.
Routes dead-lettered messages based on an exact routing key match.
Routes dead-lettered messages based on wildcard routing key patterns.
Broadcasts dead-lettered messages to all bound queues.
